nominalisation-01.why: The noun from augmenter is l’augmentation (feminine, -tion). augmentage and augmentement are invented words that don’t exist.

nominalisation-02.why: fermer → la fermeture (-ure, feminine), agreeing with prévue after it. fermation doesn’t exist; fermement is an adverb (firmly), not a noun.

nominalisation-03.why: licencier → le licenciement (-ment, masculine), hence massifs (masculine plural) after it. licenciation and licenciage don’t exist.

nominalisation-04.why: The adjective solidaire → the noun la solidarité (-té, feminine). -esse and -ise don’t apply here; solidaresse and solidarise don’t exist.

nominalisation-05.why: sage → la sagesse (-esse, feminine, like faible → faiblesse, gentil → gentillesse). sagité and sageté don’t exist.

nominalisation-06.why: franc → la franchise (-ise, feminine, frankness). francesse and franceté don’t exist.

nominalisation-07.why: Derived nouns ending in -age are masculine: le nettoyage, so the participle is masculine singular organisé. organisée treats it as feminine; organisés is plural.

nominalisation-08.why: Derived nouns ending in -ure are feminine: la signature, so the participle is reportée. reporté is masculine; reportés is masculine plural.

nominalisation-09.why: Derived nouns ending in -ment are masculine: le remboursement, so the participle is masculine singular effectué. effectuée is feminine; effectués is plural (the subject is remboursement, not frais).

nominalisation-10.why: Nouns ending in -ence are usually feminine: l’absence, so the adjective is flagrante. flagrant is masculine; flagrants wrongly agrees with transports, while the head of the subject is absence.

nominalisation-11.why: A news headline turns the verb into a noun (augmenter → la hausse), so the adverb fortement becomes an adjective modifying the noun, agreeing with the feminine noun: forte hausse. An adverb can’t modify a noun; fort lacks agreement.

nominalisation-12.why: The noun from démissionner is la démission (article dropped in a headline). démissionnement and démissionnage don’t exist.

nominalisation-13.why: The preposition of accéder à is kept after nominalisation: l’accès à la culture. l’accès de la culture would mean “culture’s access”; pour doesn’t go with accès.

nominalisation-14.why: participer à → la participation à: the preposition à is kept, and à + les = aux. des is already used for the subject (des citoyens) and can’t introduce the object too; pour les isn’t a collocation of participation.

nominalisation-15.why: s’intéresser à becomes l’intérêt pour (interest in) when nominalised — the preposition changes. l’intérêt à isn’t used in this sense; de would create two de complements and blur the meaning.

nominalisation-16.why: The complement of the noun la dépendance takes à: la dépendance au pétrole (dependence on oil). du would read as “oil’s dependence”; sur le isn’t the right collocation.

nominalisation-17.why: réduire → la réduction (-tion, feminine; the stem becomes réduc-, like produire → production). réduisation and réduisement don’t exist.

nominalisation-18.why: The noun for échouer (to fail) is l’échec (masculine), and l’échec scolaire is a set phrase. échouage means a ship running aground; échouement isn’t used for academic failure.

nominalisation-19.why: The noun from baisser is la baisse (feminine), formed with no suffix, agreeing with nette. baissement and baissure don’t exist.

nominalisation-20.why: choisir → le choix (masculine, an irregular derivation). choisition and choisissement don’t exist.

nominalisation-21.why: inquiet → l’inquiétude (-ude, feminine). inquiétance and inquiétesse don’t exist.

nominalisation-22.why: décider → la décision (-sion, feminine). décidation and décidement don’t exist.

nominalisation-23.why: fidèle → la fidélité (-té, feminine; note the stem becomes fidél-). fidélesse doesn’t exist; fidélise is a conjugated form of the verb fidéliser.

nominalisation-24.why: Adjectives ending in -ble form nouns in -bilité: lisible → la lisibilité (like possible → possibilité). lisibleté and lisiblesse don’t exist.

nominalisation-25.why: satisfait → la satisfaction (-tion, feminine). satisfaitude and satisfaisement don’t exist.

nominalisation-26.why: The derived noun le stationnement, ending in -ment, is masculine singular, so interdit. interdite is feminine; interdits is plural.

nominalisation-27.why: l’ouverture, ending in -ure, is feminine, so the participle is critiquée (the head of the subject is ouverture, not frontières). critiqué is masculine; critiqués is masculine plural.

nominalisation-28.why: en raison de is a prepositional phrase followed by a noun: en raison du retard des trains (nominalised). en raison que doesn’t exist; de retarder les trains would mean “in order to delay the trains”, not the intended meaning.

nominalisation-29.why: A news headline turns the verb into a noun and drops the article: Rénovation de la gare. The infinitive rénover and the participle rénové can’t take a de complement and a par agent to form a noun phrase in a headline.

nominalisation-30.why: indépendant → l’indépendance (-ance, feminine). indépendanté and indépendantise don’t exist.
